title: X_eTaL-video lesson
description: A lesson as data (docs/plan.md V3): lessons/<slug>/lesson.json. Checked by scripts/check-schema.mjs, which reads the keywords used here and no others.

slug.description: The lesson's directory name under lessons/.

summary.description: One or two sentences for the landing page.

order.description: Where the lesson comes on the landing page (lower first).

poster.description: The frame used as the lesson's thumbnail (its middle if not given).

youtube.description: The video's YouTube id, once the author has uploaded it (just link SLUG URL); the site embeds it. Videos are hosted on YouTube, never in git.

stepFrames.description: The frames a stepping board holds each step (15 if not given).

kind.description: 'lesson' (the default: the Lesson composition, headings and lines over the schedule) or 'story' (the Story composition: full-frame pictures and recordings, a heading in the lower third, a title card and a closing segment), for a video that is not a lesson on X_eTaL.

brand.description: A story's series name, shown on its title card (e.g. Throwback Thursday #15).

music.description: A story's music, as in video-publishing: the track's start under the opening title, its end under the close, never under narration. The file is not tracked (an absolute path or one relative to the repository).

intro.description: The track's first seconds, from the start of the video, fading out at the end.

outro.description: The track's last seconds, ending with the video, fading in at the start.

slides.description: Under each silent explainer (a scene with a slide and no narration): the middle of the track, as long as the scene, faded in and out, at this volume.

offsets.description: Seconds from the middle each silent explainer's music starts at, in order, repeating (default: half a second apart around the middle), so no two sound the same.

demo.description: The live demo the lesson is about, if any: one of this family's published pages, or any page by its URL.

start.description: A selector clicked once the page has loaded, before the recording starts (a card that starts the session with sound).

ready.description: A selector present when the page takes typed input: a 'type' action waits for it.

seconds.description: The scene's length; with narration, the audio's length replaces it.

narration.description: What is spoken over the scene (at most 320 characters). A word said two ways is marked {written|spoken}: {read|red} shows read and says red; {live|live} keeps the usual reading (just voice --check requires a decision on every one).

images.description: A story's pictures for this scene, full frame, one a sentence of its narration (the last stays): each a path relative to the repository (outside it is fine; nothing is copied into git).

clip.description: A story's ready-made segment, its video and its audio as they are (the reused closing call to action): a path relative to the repository. The scene's seconds are the clip's.

slide.description: An explainer slide (a story): the scene's heading, then its items, revealed one after another by X_eTaL's stagger. points: cards; timeline: years on a line (mark one); flow: boxes joined by arrows; table: a row an item (text, then sub as taken, not as not taken).

steps.description: A narrated slide shown a sentence at a time: for each sentence, how many items are shown (the newest marked); the last entry stays.

xtl.description: A line of X_eTaL, shown as the pinned xetal renders it.

code.description: Other code (APL), shown as it is.

not.description: For a table: the third column (what was not taken).

panel.description: A story's panel, under the scene's heading. code: lines of X_eTaL (drawn) and other code (as they are), each labeled or not, the lines named in focus brought forward for each sentence of the narration in turn (the last entry stays). cells: an array as a row of cells, from (an X_eTaL expression, evaluated by the pinned xetal) to (another), the op between; loop takes the cells one at a time over the scene (from must be a literal vector), whole takes them all at once.

box.description: A result as the pinned xetal --box draws it (APL2 DISPLAY frames), lines joined by newlines; drawn as one block, its lines set tight so the frame joins.

focus.description: For each sentence, the lines (from 0) in focus; an empty list for all.

mute.description: Play the clip without its own audio (a closing slide under this video's music).

transcript.description: A clip's own words, for the captions and the transcript: each sentence with its start and end, seconds into the clip.

curves.description: Show the three easing curves as moving dots.

capture.description: Show the recording of the lesson's demo page (scripts/capture.mjs) instead of lines. Scenes with a capture follow one another and are one recording; a scene's actions run when it starts.

url.description: Record this page instead of the lesson's demo (a story's other recordings).

scroll.description: A selector to bring to the top, or 'top'.

type.description: A line typed into the page a character at a time, at a typist's pace, then Return.

drag.description: Drag from the middle of the page by x and y pixels over some seconds (turns a 3D model).

select.description: A select's selector, then the option's label.

boards.description: Arrays drawn as grids under the lines, each one printed by the lesson's data.xtl after a '== name' line.

numbers.description: Write each cell's number in it.

heat.description: Color each cell by its number, cells touching: 'ramp' from the least to the most; 'escape' for counts of steps, the cells that have never left (as many steps as there have been) black.

points.description: The array is positions, each board 2 by N (the x row, the y row): draw the N bodies, and with animate their trails.

animate.description: A list of boards shown one at a time, a step each; otherwise all at once, side by side.

lines.description: Text, X_eTaL as {"xtl": ...}, or other code (JSON, shell, a link) as {"code": ...}. {{f}}, {{scene}}, {{local}}, {{progress}}, {{total}}, {{secs}}, {{durs}} and {{starts}} and {{step}} are replaced by the frame's own numbers.

xtl.description: A line of X_eTaL, as typed; shown as the pinned xetal renders it (decorated, colored), never as typed.
